models.sql: SELECT CustomerID, SUM(UnitPrice * Quantity * 100)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM retail GROUP BY CustomerID

tests.name: unique_customer
tests.sql: SELECT CustomerID FROM metrics GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1

config.description: Edit this actual SQL to implement the declared adopted retail policy. Editable tests do not determine final content correctness.

content.meaning: UCI InvoiceNo starting C (case insensitive) is a cancellation; UnitPrice is GBP per unit. sales_only excludes C invoices and nonpositive quantities; net_signed retains signed Quantity including cancellations. Both exclude nonpositive prices and missing CustomerID. Keep all original rows (no duplicate deletion), sum Quantity*UnitPrice in GBP and output rounded integer pence, count DISTINCT qualifying InvoiceNo. Retain every customer in data.customers with zeros as needed. Date interval is start inclusive/end exclusive using source local-naive timestamps.

models.name: metrics
models.sql: WITH valid_rows AS (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND UnitPrice > 0), revenue AS (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) * 100::BIGINT AS revenue_pence FROM valid_rows GROUP BY CustomerID), invoice_count AS (SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM valid_rows WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND Quantity > 0 GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT c.CustomerID, COALESCE(r.revenue_pence, 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COALESCE(ic.invoice_count, 0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN revenue r ON c.CustomerID = r.CustomerID LEFT JOIN invoice_count ic ON c.CustomerID = ic.CustomerID

function.name: read_alias
function.description: Read the current version at a visible workspace alias. Returns its exact reference and content. Does not adopt or hand off anything. Use read_version to choose an older exact version.

function.name: read_version
function.description: Read exactly the object_id/version_id you specify. Returns content and the same exact reference. No version is selected for you.

function.name: read_messages
function.description: Read actual messages addressed to this role, including requests and deliveries.

function.name: request_information
function.description: Ask a declared route provider for information for this work. Only a real provider decision can answer a manual route.

function.name: adopt
function.description: Bind an exact readable reference to a work input name. alias is the input name used later by sql_build, not an object ID. Reading and adopting are separate.

function.name: write_object
function.description: Write a new version of the chosen local JSON alias. Explicit dependencies are exact source references; no source is selected or added automatically. A SQL project has models[{name,sql}], tests[{name,sql}], config{exports}.

function.name: sql_build
function.description: Execute the chosen SQL project using exact work adoptions named in input_aliases; write its real result/error to output_alias. SELECT/CTE only; no files/network/extensions. This is not a correctness judgment.

function.name: sql_query
function.description: Run one SELECT/CTE against tables in a local readable source or its exact work adoption. Save actual output/error to output_alias.

function.name: preflight_submission
function.description: Check public file, source, dependency and table structure only. Does not reveal correct business values, repair files or submit.

function.name: submit
function.description: Submit current versions of the chosen workspace aliases for the work. A submission alone is not approval or business correctness.

function.name: withdraw
function.description: Withdraw the specified pending submission before replacing it; prior files and reviews remain immutable.

function.name: respond_issue
function.description: Respond to a real issue using the actual revised submission and exact evidence references.

function.name: wait
function.description: Advance world time by the declared ticks, allowing due transport events to run. Unlike staff_wait, this is a world action.

function.name: inspect_submission
function.description: Inspect an exact real submission and its fixed artifact versions. Read the versions themselves before judging them. Set include_contract=true to retrieve the complete fixed contract and all original inspection metadata; default presentation may be compact.

function.name: staff_wait
function.description: Pause this worker without changing world time or business state. Use the actual world wait tool to advance world time.

function.name: staff_done
function.description: Declare this model worker stopped. This does not submit, approve or prove work correct.

function.arguments: {"alias": "code", "data": {"config": {"description": "Edit this actual SQL to implement the declared adopted retail policy. Editable tests do not determine final content correctness.", "exports": ["metrics"]}, "models": [{"name": "metrics", "sql": "WITH valid_rows AS (SELECT * FROM retail WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND UnitPrice > 0), revenue AS (SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) * 100::BIGINT AS revenue_pence FROM valid_rows GROUP BY CustomerID), invoice_count AS (SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(DISTINCT InvoiceNo)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM valid_rows WHERE InvoiceNo NOT LIKE 'C%' AND Quantity > 0 GROUP BY CustomerID) SELECT c.CustomerID, COALESCE(r.revenue_pence, 0)::BIGINT AS revenue_pence, COALESCE(ic.invoice_count, 0)::BIGINT AS invoice_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN revenue r ON c.CustomerID = r.CustomerID LEFT JOIN invoice_count ic ON c.CustomerID = ic.CustomerID"}]}, "dependencies": [{"object_id": "obj-ce6df59356455075dcb4aa81", "version_id": "v1"}], "work_id": "TEAM::build"}
